scope: Three native material-group stages on independent props over normal building geometry, plus changing light bands in two frames

motion_comparison.note: Second frame includes the postgame UI; both sampled building regions remain unobstructed. This supports visual motion, not a frame-time benchmark.

limitations: All 24 models were audited offline; only level-one main city was inspected live.
Full 1.5-second scheduler progression and upgrade/cancel/death cleanup are covered by Lua regression tests, not claimed as a successful live end-to-end run.
An additional live timed probe was attempted after the test match ended; its results were not used.
